industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Hunan Development Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Hunan Development Group Co.,Ltd, established in Changsha, China, in 1993, is primarily involved in the hydroelectric power generation sector within China. The company oversees three operational hydropower stations, which collectively boast a substantial installed capacity of 230 megawatts. Beyond its core energy business, Hunan Development Group has diversified its operations into the senior care industry and the healthcare field, concentrating on the establishment of rehabilitation hospitals and medical treatment centers. Furthermore, the group is active in various investment ventures.
